messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary error spike detected 2026-03-15T02:42Z — inference-routing (canary) 5xxs increasing, sample rate 15-20% for long-sequence requests. Paging oncall.

Aisha (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling up routing table and logs.

Tom: Which pool is canary hitting? Dedicated eu-west pool?

Miguel: Canary is on pool-gamma (dedicated, eu-west). Logs show repeated TokenizationMismatchError across multiple worker shards.

Sasha: We flipped feature/tokenizer-v2 ~1h ago on the canary. Could be related.

Aisha (oncall): Killing the flag for canary traffic now to stop more exposure. Running: `/ops/ff kill feature/tokenizer-v2 --env prod --scope canary --reason "tokenizer mismatch 5xx"`

deploy-bot: Feature flag feature/tokenizer-v2 set to OFF for canary by Aisha (request id 7c1b9a).

Priya (Customer Ops): Which tenants saw errors? Any enterprise customers impacted? Need to notify SEs.

Miguel: Early list: rwd-42, acme-retail-prod, beta-llm-inc. Acme is on a managed plan — pinging their SE.

Tom: Stack snippet from route-handler: 
```
File "tokenizer.py", line 214, in encode
  if token_id >= vocab_size:
    raise TokenizationMismatchError("token id >= vocab size")
```
vocab_size mismatch looks likely.

Sasha: That matches my suspicion — tokenizer bundle v2 was published but pool-gamma still runs v1 quantized weights. Pipeline should have blocked this.

Aisha (oncall): For immediate mitigation, set canary route default back to previous model variant:
```
infra-cli set-route-default --route inference.text.generate --model redwood/llama-3-small:v1 --scope canary
```

deploy-bot: Route default updated to redwood/llama-3-small:v1 for canary scope by Aisha.

Miguel: Tailing logs — error rate dropping from ~18% to ~1% after the routing fallback. In-flight failures remain for a short window.

(1m later)

Miguel: Error rate now ~0.8%. GPU/CPU healthy. Will keep monitoring.

Priya (Customer Ops): Notified Acme SE with a short blurb: "We observed intermittent 5xxs for canary users due to a tokenizer-model mismatch; mitigation applied and monitoring continues."

Sasha: Root cause prelim: build pipeline published tokenizer artifact v2 without verifying compatible model weights/quantization. We didn't gate bundle publish on model-version parity.

Tom: I can prepare a minimal revert to remove the tokenizer flag flip from rollout-config: `git revert --no-commit 9f4c3b2` then PR. Keep it single commit.

Aisha (oncall): Please do the revert and get CI green, then merge. We'll do a controlled rollback.

Tom: PR opened: revert-tokenizer-flip-3098765432. CI running. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/817

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #817 (rollout-config). Ready to merge.

Miguel: Before merge, let's sanity-check pool-gamma node compatibility: `curl -s -X POST http://pool-gamma/debug/check-tokenizer -d '{"model":"llama-3-small","tokenizer":"v2"}'`

Sasha: Running that now on one node.

(3m later)

Sasha: Compat check result: expected_vocab=50288, node_vocab=49152 -> mismatch confirmed. So v2 tokenizer can't be used with current weights on pool-gamma.

Tom: Merging revert PR.

deploy-bot: PR #817 merged by Tom. Deploying rollout-config to production (canary stage).

deploy-bot: rollout-config deploy started. Canary stage in progress.

Aisha (oncall): I'll watch the canary for 30m and then hand off to oncall-2. @Tom you'll be primary after me; @Miguel keep telemetry. @Sasha own the build-pipeline fix.

Miguel: After merge, traffic slowly returned to baseline. Error rate steady at ~0.3-0.5%.

Priya (Customer Ops): Acme replied — they saw intermittent dashboard errors. I sent an update: "Issue mitigated by reverting tokenizer rollout; engineering is investigating permanent fix. We'll follow up with timeline."

Sasha: Filing infra ticket to enforce model-tokenizer bundle checks on publish: BUILD-1983 created and assigned to infra-build. Link: https://tickets.internal/BUILD-1983

Tom: Also creating a small server-side guard to prevent route switches that would pair incompatible tokenizer/model combos. Will PR that after dinner.

Aisha (oncall): Handoff in 30m: @Tom primary, @Miguel telemetry, @Sasha pipeline, @Priya customer comms.

(30m later)

Tom: Verified stability for 45m. No new customer-facing 5xxs. Preparing incident summary for postmortem.

Priya (Customer Ops): Sent final note to Acme and internal SEs: "Resolved: revert applied; monitoring continues. No customer data exposed. SE will follow up if any residual issues." :white_check_mark:

Aisha (oncall): Incident ticket INC-2026-145 created. Summary: timeline, root cause (tokenizer/model bundle version mismatch), mitigations (feature flag kill, route fallback, single-commit revert), customer impact (intermittent 5xxs for ~25-30 minutes affecting rwd-42, acme-retail-prod, beta-llm-inc), follow-ups (BUILD-1983, routing guard PR). I'll file the postmortem doc.

Miguel: Adding log excerpts and the compat check output to the incident doc.

Tom: Adding git hashes and infra commands we executed to the ticket:
```
git revert -m 1 9f4c3b2
infra-cli set-route-default --route inference.text.generate --model redwood/llama-3-small:v1 --scope canary
/ops/ff kill feature/tokenizer-v2 --env prod --scope canary --reason "tokenizer mismatch"
```

Sasha: Linking BUILD-1983 and upcoming routing-guard PR in action items.

Priya (Customer Ops): I'll do a follow-up tomorrow with Acme and CC SOC/legal for audit notes.

Aisha (oncall): Closing active paging, leaving incident in monitoring. Thanks team. :heart:

Tom: Closing handoff — will monitor for 2 hours then mark resolved if stable.

(End of thread)
